name: Pre-emergent
description__value: when basic and applied scientific advances develop new ideas, materials, methods and processes that show promise but have not yet been released for uncontrolled use in the real world

name: Emergent
description__value: the period once a new technology or innovation begins to emerge in day-to-day use by agrifood systems agents and enterprises outside researchers’ control, but it remains sufficiently novel that no systematic accounting for its diffusion is in place yet

name: Mature
description__value: established science, technologies or innovations that have been in real world use sufficiently long and widely that systematic tracking of diffusion should be feasible
